title: A training-only false-signal rate ordered 2005-2024 climate forecast skill in six new data families (14,312 series), but a null-calibrated rule did not beat the response-class rule
abstract: Question: can training years alone, without a response-class label, show which climate-response relations in an untested system will keep forecast skill? Approach: campaign publication sci:sha256:7b03c5d9 proposed, after its pre-registered tests, a shifted-climate null: a family false-signal rate (FSR) and a null-calibrated rule (Rule_q: frozen climate slope with a 5-year trailing level if q <= 0.2 and cross-validated R2 >= 0.10, else the trailing mean). We froze this recipe in a timestamped plan and applied it without change to six new families (14,312 series; training to 2004, test 2005-2024): US river flow, lake and river ice dates, Japanese cherry flowering, US breeding bird counts, peak-season NDVI and national dengue cases. Results: FSR (0.11-0.13 for rivers, ice and cherry; 0.58-0.86 for NDVI, dengue and birds) ordered the families by forward skill of signalled series (Spearman -0.77 in new families; -0.91 over 13 units, permutation p = 0.0003) and by slope-sign persistence (100% in the physical families, 50% in birds). Rule_q was near the best fixed strategy in 5 of 6 families, but in dengue trend-correlated windows passed the null and failed (regret 0.09; 21% of countries lost). Rule_q beat climate-for-all, trailing-mean-for-all and the rule without the null, but it was 0.014 below the response-class rule (95% interval -0.026 to -0.0005); the class rule chose the best strategy in all six families. In US birds the training signal had the size of chance (in-sample R2 0.234 vs 0.219 under the null) and ranked forward skill inversely. Exploratory: FSR predicted held-out unit outcomes better than class (MAE 0.22 vs 0.30), and a family FSR gate (tau 0.23-0.41) equalled the class rule in new families and beat it in the five earlier ones. Limitations: one or two families per class; crop yields were dropped (truncated input); GHCN-CAMS replaced truncated CRU temperature; exploratory results need a new prospective test.
